findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "polymarket_trader_alerts" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Webhook alerts when Polymarket traders trade, for 7 days: up to 5 wallets (signer or proxy) and a minimum size (default $500). We read each trader's trades abou…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "prediction-markets" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: polymarket_trader_alerts, x_accounts_polymarket_bets · Private data: polymarket_trader_profile, polymarket_smart_money, polymarket_top_traders, polymarket_trader_alerts, hyperliquid_trader_profile, x_handle_wallets, x_accounts_polymarket_bets, wallet_trader_pnl, polymarket_big_trades · Public sink: polymarket_trader_alerts, hyperliquid_smart_money, x_accounts_polymarket_bets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: polymarket_trader_alerts, x_accounts_polymarket_bets · Private data: polymarket_trader_profile, polymarket_smart_money, polymarket_top_traders, polymarket_trader_alerts, hyperliquid_trader_profile, x_handle_wallets, x_accounts_polymarket_bets, wallet_trader_pnl, polymarket_big_trades · Public sink: polymarket_trader_alerts, hyperliquid_smart_money, x_accounts_polymarket_bets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
